lines.text: Hezekiah tears his clothes, puts on sackcloth, enters the house of the LORD, and sends Eliakim and Shebna to Isaiah.
The LORD says Assyria's king will hear a rumor and return home, and Sennacherib is fighting against Libnah.
Hezekiah spreads the letter before the LORD in the royal treasury and prays to the Maker of heaven and earth.
The LORD says Assyria's king will not shoot an arrow into Jerusalem, and He defends it for Moses.
The angel of the LORD strikes down 185,000 Assyrians, and Sennacherib returns to Nineveh, where his sons kill him.
